calls.head: Different shooting spots
calls.body: On point-shot reliance, Anaheim sits 8th of 32, at the point-heavy end of the scale. Florida is 31st, at the down low end.
calls.call: Anaheim takes a bigger share of its shots from the point than Florida.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shot attempts from the point, Anaheim had 48% and Florida 42%. Coming in, Anaheim was at 42% and Florida at 38%.

calls.head: Florida keeps shots outside; Anaheim lets them in
calls.body: Florida ranks 5th of 32 for quality allowed, toward the sheltered end; Anaheim ranks 27th, toward the exposed end.
calls.call: Florida keeps the shots it allows further from danger than Anaheim does.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 1 games this season

surprises.body: Replaying this game’s chances, Florida comes out ahead 82 times in 100. Anaheim won anyway.
